description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Peter Parker, adding {C}{C}.
When Peter Parker dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Peter Parker from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Peter Parker enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
